name: Panel-Leg Bench
description: Hallway bench: 1200 x 350 x 40 mm seat at 450 mm height on two full-depth panel legs, tied by a central stretcher rail.

steps.instruction: Create the bench seat: a 1200 x 350 mm slab, 40 mm thick, centered in X and Y, top face at Z=450 (slab from Z=410 to Z=450).

transcript.user_prompt: Build a hallway bench. Start with the seat: a slab 1200 mm long (X), 350 mm deep (Y) and 40 mm thick, centered in X and Y with its top face at Z=450, so it spans Z=410 to Z=450.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 1200 x 350 mm bench seat, 40 mm thick with its surface at 450 mm sitting height.

steps.instruction: Add two panel legs 40 mm thick and 350 mm deep (full seat depth), from Z=0 to Z=410, centered at X=+/-480 (outer faces inset 100 mm from the seat ends), fused with the seat.

transcript.user_prompt: Give it two solid panel legs: each 40 mm thick, the full 350 mm depth of the seat, running from the floor at Z=0 to the seat's underside at Z=410. Center them at X=+/-480 so the outer faces are inset 100 mm from the seat ends, and fuse them with the seat.
transcript.assistant_message: Both panel legs are under the seat at X=+/-480, full depth, 100 mm in from each end.

steps.instruction: Add a stretcher rail between the legs: 1000 mm long (spanning the legs' outer faces), 30 mm wide and 80 mm tall, centered in Y, from Z=200 to Z=280, fused through both legs.

transcript.user_prompt: Tie the legs together with a stretcher: a rail 1000 mm long so it spans flush to the legs' outer faces, 30 mm wide and 80 mm tall, centered in Y, running from Z=200 to Z=280 and fused through both legs.
transcript.assistant_message: The stretcher rail now runs leg-to-leg at 200-280 mm height, bracing the bench into a single rigid frame.
